info.title: glacier
info.description: High-performance pure C# .NET 10 LLM command-line application (glacier). Features interactive chat REPL, side-by-side comparative benchmarking against Ollama GPU, model inspection, and Ollama/OpenAI-compatible HTTP serving.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ║        Zero Native C++ DLLs | Sub-100ms Cold Start | Hardware SIMD    ║

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Inspect model architecture, metadata & tensors
bench   <model.gguf> [options]       Run speed & comparative benchmark
run     <model.gguf> [prompt]        Interactive streaming chat or single prompt
serve   <model.gguf> [options]       Start Ollama & OpenAI compatible HTTP server
